info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create System Deployment Review-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of system deployment reviews within the IT management domain of banking services. It allows users to initiate reviews for specific system deployments identified by the parameter in the URL. Typical consumers of this API include IT managers and deployment teams who are responsible for ensuring deployment quality and compliance. The API streamlines the review process, enhancing oversight and facilitating collaborative feedback to improve deployment outcomes.

post.summary: Create a review for system deployment.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified system deployment resource. Ensure that all necessary data is included in the request body to successfully create a review.
